chunks: And whatever is in it from Ḥamdān ibn al-Ḥusayn, I have narrated it from ʿAlī ibn Ḥātim by authorization. He said: al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad informed us. He said: Ḥamdān ibn al-Ḥusayn narrated to us.

key_terms.أَخْبَرَنَا: he informed us; a transmission term in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.حَدَّثَنَا: he narrated to us; a transmission term in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ḥamdān ibn al-Ḥusayn in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the transmission chain to Ḥamdān ibn al-Ḥusayn in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It records that the author received these narrations from ʿAlī ibn Ḥātim by ijāzah, through al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Ḥamdān ibn al-Ḥusayn.
